summary: Review web application risks, prioritize findings and prepare release actions. Explore this five-day foundation course.
lede: Web security training helps developers, QA analysts and application support teams assess application-level risks in web releases. Participants learn to map routes and trust boundaries, review HTTP and session controls, and assess input handling and browser policies. They also classify and prioritize vulnerabilities, verify remediation, and prepare release-focused review notes using OWASP guidance.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for professionals who review, build, test or support web applications and need a repeatable way to identify and report application-level security weaknesses.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with web applications and browser-based workflows is expected. No coding or prior penetration-testing experience is required.
